ctx.x: Then we had, uh, Dandy Lewis on bass. You heard of him. Yeah, I've heard Bess talk about him. That's right. Dandy Lewis. That's who we had on bass. Then after Buddy Johnson left, we taken Earl Umphrey on trombone. He played up there with us. Then... Manny Mineta come up there with us a while. Yeah, he told us he did. Yeah, he come up. He played with us a while. We had a nice band. Five band. We used to have two bands. Celestine, our band, and they had the big carnival bars. They hired two bands. Sometime they'd…
Something like that? Or was it Lawson?

No, Harvey Lightfoot. Harvey Lightfoot. Yeah, that's his name. He's on record, too. Yeah. Harvey, wait. Is he still living? I don't know. Harvey Lightfoot. Mm-hmm. And he had a drummer.
